## Hypothesis

Adjusting SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK parameters (vol_mult, body_min_cents, min_stars, strike_offset, etc.) can improve edge capture on J's winner days while avoiding losses on loser days. The top keeper from the overnight grinder sweep shows high wide_pnl but low edge_capture, suggesting the parameter set may be overfit to non-J days.

## Mechanism

Entry: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with vol_mult=1.3, body_min_cents=0.05, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true.
